d: Addressing a press conference, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das strongly rejected allegations of foreign funding leveled by Union Minister Jitendra Singh. Responding to claims of financial links with Pakistan, Nepal, Bangladesh, and the United States, Ranka and Das labeled the charges as baseless and a recurring tactic to deflect from real national issues. They questioned why government officials had previously held discussions and met with them if such concerns existed.
